claims.statement: Regulation (EU) 2025/40 covers all packaging and establishes lifecycle, sustainability, labelling, and extended-producer-responsibility requirements.
The Commission says the PPWR entered into force on 11 February 2025 and generally applies from 12 August 2026.

contrary_evidence: Large packaging groups may build compliance checks internally, and harmonized guidance may commoditize basic rules.

economics.acquisition_route: One-to-many acquisition through packaging printers, label converters, and their MIS or ERP vendors.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: five channel integrations and 100 brands by year two can grow to 350 brands at 24000 PLN annual revenue by year five, making a majority founder stake plausibly exceed 5 million PLN without double-counting retained cash.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 3-4 founder hours daily for product and partner enablement, with packaging-law review contracted out.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 75-85% gross margin after automated checks, amortized expert review, storage, and channel revenue share.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: an 8000 PLN integration and enablement cost pays back within six months after 15 activated brand customers.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis, including the capital figure: 690 PLN per SKU dossier, 199 PLN per annual refresh, or 4900 PLN monthly API bundles.
economics.retention_or_repeat: A paid event recurs for every new SKU, artwork change, material substitution, and annual evidence refresh.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Rights to anonymized material decisions, exceptions, and accepted remediation outcomes improve the rules engine
fingerprint.customer: EU consumer-brand SMEs and packaging compliance managers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded reseller integration inside printer and converter quoting workflows
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: API-generated PPWR evidence dossier sold per event and by channel bundle
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The brand owner pays when a SKU dossier is approved or refreshed
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A packaging SKU is created or its artwork, supplier, or material changes

founder_fit: The rules engine suits data-science automation, part-time validation, low capital, and low-camera one-to-many selling.
risks: Wrong classifications could delay launches or create liability, so the product must remain an evidence workflow with qualified review rather than legal certification.

structure.control_point: The evidence check immediately before packaging artwork is approved for production
structure.critical_dependency: Printer integrations plus reliable legal and material-classification updates

thesis: Embed a packaging-compliance preflight in printers' and converters' quoting flows, charging on every SKU or material revision while contractually pooling anonymized outcomes into a hard-to-copy classification corpus.
title: PackProof Embedded PPWR Preflight
uncertainties: Unknown willingness of converters to share specification and remediation outcomes under reusable data rights.
